scripts.postinstall: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); if (fs.existsSync('scripts/generate.cjs')) require('node:child_process').execSync('pnpm run generate', { stdio: 'inherit' });"
scripts.generate: node scripts/generate.cjs && prettier --ignore-path ../../.prettierignore --write src/index.ts src/si.ts src/tb.ts
